column1: TC_ID | Title | Preconditions | Steps | Expected Result

PROF-001 | Profile screen loads successfully | User is logged in, has passed First-Login Verification, GET /api/me succeeds | 1. Navigate to the Profile screen 2. Wait for load to finish | Loading spinner is replaced by full content: avatar with initials, "Member — {plan} Edition" subtitle, Hours/Finished/Shelved stat tiles, usage card, premium card, "Account" section header and account rows all render

PROF-002 | Loading indicator shown while profile fetches | Profile screen just opened, GET /api/me not yet resolved | 1. Open Profile screen 2. Observe immediately | An MwLoader spinner is centered on screen; no content renders until loading completes

PROF-003 | Profile load failure shows error view with Retry | GET /api/me throws/fails | 1. Open Profile screen 2. Simulate /api/me failure | Spinner is replaced by an error view reading "Could not load your profile: {error}" centered, with a "Retry" text button beneath; no profile content shown

PROF-004 | Retry after failure reloads the profile | Profile screen is in the error state from a prior /api/me failure | 1. From the error view tap "Retry" 2. Ensure /api/me now succeeds | Screen re-enters loading state then renders the profile content normally; error message clears

PROF-005 | Pull-to-refresh reloads profile data | Profile screen has already loaded once | 1. Pull down on the list to trigger RefreshIndicator 2. Observe | _load() re-runs: identity, stats, usage and premium cards refresh with the latest server data

PROF-006 | Secondary data failure degrades only its own card | GET /api/me succeeds but one of GET /api/me/stats, GET /api/me/entitlements, GET /api/billing/subscription or GET /api/plans fails | 1. Open Profile with one secondary endpoint failing 2. Observe which sections render | Only the card tied to that failed call degrades (e.g. stat tiles show "—", or usage card shows "Usage is unavailable right now."); the rest of the page renders normally because each secondary call is wrapped independently in a try/catch that returns null on failure

PROF-007 | Edit-name dialog opens prefilled; Cancel discards | Profile loaded, full name known | 1. Tap the pencil icon next to the display name 2. Observe dialog is prefilled 3. Change the text then tap "Cancel" | "Your name" dialog opens with the field pre-filled and focused; tapping "Cancel" closes it with no PATCH /api/me call and the displayed name unchanged

PROF-008 | Saving an unchanged or empty name is a no-op | Edit-name dialog open | 1. Open edit-name dialog 2. Leave the name unchanged, or clear the field entirely 3. Tap "Save" | No PATCH /api/me call is made (newName null/empty/equal to current short-circuits before the API call); UI unchanged

PROF-009 | Saving a new valid name updates the profile | Edit-name dialog open with a different, non-empty name entered | 1. Open dialog, enter "Jane Doe" 2. Tap "Save" | A brief spinner replaces the edit icon; PATCH /api/me is called with full_name="Jane Doe" (trimmed); on success the displayed name updates to the new value

PROF-010 | Saving name failure shows an error snackbar | PATCH /api/me fails after Save is tapped | 1. Edit name, tap "Save" 2. Simulate PATCH /api/me failure | Saving spinner clears; snackbar reads "Could not save your name: {error}"; previously displayed name is retained

PROF-011 | Member badge text reflects plan-name resolution logic | (a) UserProfile.plan is empty (b) plan id matches the fetched premium Plan.id (c) plan is non-empty but GET /api/plans failed or has no matching plan | 1. Load Profile with plan="" 2. Load Profile with plan equal to a fetched premium Plan.id 3. Load Profile with plan="premium" and no matching Plan available | (a) subtitle reads "Member — Free Edition"; (b) subtitle reads "Member — {Plan.name}" (the real display name, e.g. "Premium Edition"); (c) subtitle falls back to a capitalized id, e.g. "Member — Premium Edition"

PROF-012 | Stat tiles show placeholders when stats unavailable | GET /api/me/stats failed | 1. Load Profile with the stats call failing | Hours, Finished and Shelved tiles each display "—" instead of a number

PROF-013 | Stat tiles show zero-padded values | GET /api/me/stats returns hoursListened=7, finished=3, shelved=12 | 1. Load Profile with those stats values | Tiles render "07" (Hours), "03" (Finished), "12" (Shelved) — each rounded and left-padded to 2 digits

PROF-014 | Usage card shows unavailable message when entitlements missing | GET /api/me/entitlements failed | 1. Load Profile with the entitlements call failing | Usage card renders only the text "Usage is unavailable right now." with no limit rows

PROF-015 | Usage card renders plan header and formatted limit values | GET /api/me/entitlements succeeds with plan and mixed limit types (counter, unlimited, flag) | 1. Load Profile with entitlements plan="premium" and limits including a counted item, an unlimited item (limit=-1) and a capability flag | Header reads "PREMIUM · USAGE"; a counted limit shows "{used} of {limit}" (e.g. "3 of 5"); an unlimited one shows "{used} of infinity"; a flag shows "Included" or "Not included" per its allowed value

PROF-016 | Usage rows near their limit or disallowed are highlighted | A counted limit's used/limit fraction is >=0.8, or a flag limit has allowed=false | 1. Load Profile with a limit at 80%+ usage and a flag limit with allowed=false | Both rows render their value text in the accent (warning) color rather than the default ink color; a flag with allowed=true and a limit below 80% render in the default color

PROF-017 | Usage card shows renewal date when present | entitlements.renewsAt is set | 1. Load Profile with entitlements.renews_at set to a future date | Below the limit rows, text reads "Renews {Month Year}" (e.g. "Renews March 2027")

PROF-018 | Premium card visibility and content for a free user | No non-free plan exists from GET /api/plans (card hidden case) vs. a premium Plan is available and user is on free tier (upsell case) | 1. Load Profile with GET /api/plans returning no non-free plan 2. Load Profile again with a premium Plan available and user on the free plan | (1) Neither the upsell card nor the state card renders (SizedBox.shrink); (2) an ink-colored card shows the plan name uppercase, "The full library" heading, perks numbered "i.", "ii.", "iii." etc, price label (e.g. "$9.99") and period label (e.g. "/ month"), an "Upgrade" button and a "Restore purchases" link

PROF-019 | Declining the upgrade dialog makes no billing call | Free user taps "Upgrade" on the premium card | 1. Tap "Upgrade" 2. Observe dialog titled "Switch to {Plan.name}?" explaining no charge is made 3. Tap "Not now" | Dialog closes; POST /api/billing/checkout is never called; user stays on the free plan

PROF-020 | Confirming upgrade switches the plan | Upgrade confirmation dialog is open | 1. Tap "Upgrade" 2. Tap "Switch" | Button shows a loading state; POST /api/billing/checkout is called with the premium plan id; profile reloads; a snackbar reads "You're on {Plan.name}."

PROF-021 | Upgrade failure shows an error toast | POST /api/billing/checkout fails after confirming | 1. Tap "Upgrade", tap "Switch" 2. Simulate checkout failure | Loading state clears; snackbar reads "Could not switch plans: {error}"; plan remains unchanged

PROF-022 | Restore purchases finds vs. does not find a prior purchase | POST /api/billing/restore returns isPremium=true (found) or isPremium=false (not found) | 1. Tap "Restore purchases" with a prior purchase on the account 2. Repeat for an account with none | (1) Profile reloads and a snackbar reads "Premium restored." with the state card now shown; (2) snackbar reads "No previous purchase found on this account." and the user stays on the free plan

PROF-023 | Restore purchases failure shows an error toast | POST /api/billing/restore throws | 1. Tap "Restore purchases" 2. Simulate a network/server failure | Snackbar reads "Could not restore purchases: {error}"

PROF-024 | Premium state card reflects Active / Renewing / Cancelled status | User is premium: (a) no renewsAt at all (b) renewsAt set, not cancelled (c) cancelled (cancelledAt set) with a known expiry | 1. Load Profile with case (a) 2. Load with case (b) 3. Load with case (c) | (a) status text reads "Active."; (b) reads "Renews {Month Year}." with a "Cancel Premium" button; (c) reads "Cancelled — yours until {Month Year}." with a "Renew Premium" button instead, which re-invokes the upgrade flow when tapped

PROF-025 | Declining cancellation keeps the subscription | Premium, not-yet-cancelled user taps "Cancel Premium" | 1. Tap "Cancel Premium" 2. Observe dialog titled "Cancel Premium?" reading "Premium will not renew. You keep it until {Month Year}." (or "Premium will not renew." if no expiry known) 3. Tap "Keep it" | Dialog closes; DELETE /api/billing/subscription is never called; subscription remains active/uncancelled

PROF-026 | Confirming cancellation stops renewal without ending access | Cancel confirmation dialog is open | 1. Tap "Cancel Premium" 2. Tap "Cancel it" | DELETE /api/billing/subscription is called; profile reloads; premium card now shows the cancelled copy and "Renew Premium" button; access is retained until the existing expiry date

PROF-027 | Cancel subscription failure shows an error toast | DELETE /api/billing/subscription fails after confirming | 1. Tap "Cancel Premium", tap "Cancel it" 2. Simulate API failure | Snackbar reads "Could not cancel: {error}"; subscription state remains unchanged

PROF-028 | Account section shows sign-in method and membership info | Profile loaded with createdAt, onboardingPath and privacyAckAt values present | 1. Scroll to the "Account" section 2. Inspect the info rows | "Signs in with" shows linked providers joined by " · " (or "Email & password" if none linked and hasPassword is true, else "Unknown"); "Member since" shows the month/year of createdAt; "Joined for" shows the mapped label ("Exploring audiobooks" / "Preserving a voice" / "Staying close to someone"); "Privacy charter" shows "Accepted" or "Not accepted yet" depending on whether privacyAckAt is set

PROF-029 | Private vault row navigates to the Vault screen | Profile loaded | 1. Scroll to Account section 2. Tap the "Private vault" row (subtitle "Encrypted audio kept only on this device") | App navigates (push) to VaultScreen, passing the current session user

PROF-030 | Log out signs the user out immediately | Profile screen loaded | 1. Scroll to bottom 2. Tap "Log out" | onLogout() is invoked directly with no confirmation dialog, returning the app to its logged-out/login state

PROF-031 | Delete-account dialog warns of irreversible loss; Keep it cancels | Profile screen loaded | 1. Tap "Delete my account" 2. Observe dialog titled "Delete your account?" warning that voice recordings, audiobooks and documents are removed, that voice recordings cannot be re-created, and that this cannot be undone 3. Tap "Keep it" | Dialog closes; DELETE /api/me is never called; user remains logged in on Profile

PROF-032 | Confirming deletion removes the account and logs out | Delete-account confirmation dialog is open | 1. Tap "Delete my account" 2. Tap "Delete forever" | DELETE /api/me is called with body {"confirm":"DELETE"}; on success onLogout() runs, returning the user to the logged-out state

PROF-033 | Account deletion failure keeps the user logged in | DELETE /api/me fails after confirming | 1. Tap "Delete my account", tap "Delete forever" 2. Simulate API failure | Snackbar reads "Could not delete the account: {error}"; onLogout is not called; user remains on Profile with the account intact

VLT-001 | Vault initializes a per-user encrypted store | User navigated to Private vault (Profile -> Private vault) with a known session email | 1. Open Private vault | init() lower-cases the email, creates (if missing) a directory named "vault_{sanitized email}" under app documents, ensures a 256-bit AES-GCM key exists in SharedPreferences for that user, then loads entries; a loading spinner is shown until this completes

VLT-002 | Loading indicator shown while vault initializes | Vault screen just opened, init()/getEntries() not yet resolved | 1. Navigate to Private vault 2. Observe immediately | An MwLoader spinner is centered; no status card, import button or entry list renders until init completes

VLT-003 | Status card text reflects verification state | (a) session user.isVerified = true (b) = false | 1. Open Private vault as a verified user 2. Open again as an unverified user | (a) subtitle reads "AES-256-GCM · identity verified · never leaves this device"; (b) subtitle reads "AES-256-GCM · verification pending · never leaves this device". Ambiguity: the vault screen only displays this status text — it does not itself re-check liveness or block access when unverified; any gating happens earlier in the login/verification flow

VLT-004 | Empty vault shows the empty state | User has zero stored vault entries | 1. Open Private vault with no entries | "In the vault" header shows no count badge; body shows the WaveLogo, "Your vault is empty" heading and "Import an audio file — it is encrypted the moment it arrives." message instead of a list

VLT-005 | Vault with entries lists them newest-first with a count | User has 2+ previously imported entries | 1. Open Private vault with multiple entries stored | "In the vault" header shows the entry count (e.g. "2"); entries are sorted by createdAt descending (most recently imported first)

VLT-006 | Import restricts the file picker to audio types | User taps "Import & encrypt an audio file" | 1. Tap the import button 2. Observe the file picker | Picker opens restricted to extensions mp3, m4a, aac, wav, ogg, single-file selection only

VLT-007 | Cancelling the file picker is a no-op | Import button tapped, picker opened | 1. Tap "Import & encrypt an audio file" 2. Dismiss/cancel the picker without selecting a file | No encryption occurs, entry list unchanged, no snackbar shown (the method returns early when the picked path is null)

VLT-008 | Importing a valid file encrypts and saves it | A valid audio file is selected from the picker | 1. Tap import, select a valid mp3 file 2. Wait for processing | Import button shows a loading state; file bytes are encrypted with AES-256-GCM using a random 12-byte nonce; ciphertext is written to "{id}.abk" in the user's vault directory; a new VaultEntry (nonce, mac, original byte length, display name) is prepended to the index and persisted; snackbar reads "Encrypted and saved to your vault."; the new entry appears at the top of the list

VLT-009 | Import failure shows an error and leaves the vault unchanged | Encryption or file read throws during import (e.g. simulated failure after the file is picked) | 1. Attempt to import a file that triggers a failure | Snackbar reads "Failed to encrypt this file."; entry list is not modified; loading state clears

VLT-010 | Vault entry row displays name, status and size | At least one entry exists | 1. Open Private vault with an entry present 2. Inspect the row | Row shows the original filename (up to 2 lines, ellipsized), an "Encrypted" status pill, and size in KB computed as originalByteLength / 1024 to one decimal place

VLT-011 | Decrypting an entry creates a temporary preview copy | An entry exists in the vault | 1. Tap the decrypt (lock-open) icon on an entry | File is decrypted with the stored per-user key plus the entry's nonce/mac into a temp file named "preview_{id}{ext}" (extension from the display name, defaulting to ".mp3" if none); snackbar shows "Decrypted temp copy: {path}" for 4 seconds

VLT-012 | Decrypt failure is surfaced without crashing | Decryption throws (e.g. corrupted ciphertext or mismatched mac) | 1. Tap the decrypt icon on an entry whose ciphertext/mac cannot be verified | Snackbar reads "Decrypt failed."; the encrypted entry remains untouched in the list

VLT-013 | Deleting an entry removes it from the list and disk | An entry exists in the vault | 1. Tap the delete (trash) icon on an entry | Entry is removed from the persisted index immediately, and its encrypted ".abk" file is deleted from disk if present; the list refreshes without that entry

VLT-014 | Decrypt/delete controls are disabled during an in-flight operation | An import, decrypt or delete is currently running (_working = true) | 1. Start an import 2. While it is in progress, attempt to tap another entry's decrypt or delete icon | Icon buttons are disabled (onPressed null) while _working is true, preventing concurrent vault operations

VLT-015 | Vault storage is scoped per user account | Two different accounts (different emails) each have their own vault entries | 1. Open Private vault as User A, import a file 2. Log out, log in as User B, open Private vault | User B sees an empty vault (or only User B's own prior entries) since the index key, encryption key and storage directory are all namespaced by the lower-cased account email — User A's entries are not visible or decryptable with User B's key
